title: Restore archived history reads for a project in a repository subdirectory
description: restore archived history reads for a project in a repository subdirectory
acceptance_criteria: A project rooted in a subdirectory of its Git repository refuses a workflow-version downgrade that a later commit restored, both on a live read and from the warm read cache.
That same project still follows an earlier dated archive path, so a downgrade that exists only on that path is refused after reopen and rearchive.
